items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: Ronnie Verrell was the drummer, an English drummer for the group in the band in London, and he was a marvelous drummer.

ctx.x: When he played the room? And he played the stage and stuff.

And walks down and plays all over the stage. And then at the end the dialogue is they bring Animal, “kill, kill, kill, drum battle, drum battle, kill.” And Buddy’s looking at him and he says, “who’s this?” He says, “that’s Animal.” He says, “he looks like an animal.” He says, “if he breaks his chain you’ll look like an animal.” So anyway it was fantastic. So they get up there and they play back and forth, and Ronnie Verrell was the drummer, an English drummer for the group in the band in London, and he was a…
Yeah. You have a copy of that you said?
